description: QuoteForm component regression: successful send, resend, and approve actions each await and invoke the parent refresh callback exactly once; representative returned action errors and thrown failures do not invoke it.

QuotesTab component regression: the callback passed to a detail-view QuoteForm runs loadData in background mode, fetches a new list snapshot, updates Active/Sent membership and counts from draft or approved to sent, and does not replace the detail form with the initial loading state.

Manual smoke: open an Active quote in detail view, send it successfully, return to the list without a browser refresh, and verify it is absent from Active, present in Sent, and both counts changed; repeat a successful resend and approval to confirm the list snapshot refreshes without a loading flash.
